title: Presovsky bus stops
description: In Slovakia, if you see this bus stop that looks like a yellow “No Entry” sign, you're in the northeastern part of the country—in the Presvosky region.

title: H-frame pylon with widening legs
description: Czechia and Slovakia have a unique H-frame design whose legs widen significantly towards the bottom. Delta pylons are often used for direction changes on these lines.

title: Chat pylon with low crossarms
description: Czech and Slovak chat pylons (a cat-face shape) have their crossarms set particularly low. In Slovakia they occur in the western part of the country; a variant with straight crossarms is unique to Slovakia.
